capabilities: extract text from PDF, Word, PowerPoint and plain-text files
copy the original file into the vault and embed it in the note
generate notes with frontmatter for source file, conversion method and import time
batch convert files via drag-and-drop, file dialog or command palette
configure target and asset folders for converted notes
extras: Desktop only because it calls a local Python process; scanned PDFs and images are imported without OCR (no text extraction); old .doc files are unsupported; distribution is currently via BRAT or manual install, with community marketplace listing pending.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn local documents like PDFs, Word files and slides into notes with their text extracted and the source file attached.

requires.name: Python 3 with pdfplumber, python-docx and python-pptx

summary: Document importer that converts PDF, Word, PowerPoint, plain-text and image files into Markdown notes, embedding a copy of the original file.
